name: com.fogboundgames.levelforge
description: A generic, game-agnostic closed-loop engine: generate a candidate, evaluate it against a difficulty target, mutate parameters, retry within a bounded budget until the target is met (or fail with a clear diagnostic). Contains no game-specific rules - each project supplies a small adapter (IDifficultyEvaluator + IParameterSpace) that wraps its own generator/solver. See ADAPTER_GUIDE.md.
